results.name: heldout-who-is-the-policyholder-for-each-policy-0862e2
results.goldMatchReason: a gold column has no matching result column

answer.sql:
SELECT po.Policy_Identifier, po.Policy_Number, pt.Party_Identifier, pt.Party_Name, COALESCE(pe.First_Name || ' ' || pe.Last_Name, o.Organization_Name) AS Policyholder
FROM policy po
JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier
JOIN party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN party pt ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = pt.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.Organization_Identifier = pt.Party_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%policyholder%'
   OR pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%policy holder%';

SELECT p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier, per.First_Name, per.Middle_Name, per.Last_Name
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN party_role pr ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
LEFT JOIN person per ON apr.Party_Identifier = per.Person_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) = 'agent';

SELECT p.Person_Identifier, p.First_Name, p.Middle_Name, p.Last_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code
FROM policy pol
JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN person p ON p.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
WHERE pol.Policy_Number = 31003000336;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Role_Code
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
WHERE pe.First_Name = 'Bob'
  AND pe.Last_Name = 'Agent'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.Expiration_Date) = 2020;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number
FROM person pe
JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
JOIN party_role pr ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
WHERE pe.First_Name = 'Mary'
  AND pe.Last_Name = 'Holder'
  AND pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%policy%holder%';

SELECT DISTINCT p.*
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
WHERE pe.First_Name = 'Bob'
  AND pr.Party_Role_Name = 'Agent';

  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM c.Claim_Open_Date) = 2019
),
paid AS (
  SELECT cv.Policy_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS paid_loss
  FROM covered cv
  JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cv.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY cv.Policy_Identifier
),
prem AS (
  SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium p ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM pa.Effective_Date) = 2019
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
  pol.Policy_Identifier,
  COALESCE(paid.paid_loss, 0) AS paid_loss,
  prem.premium,
  COALESCE(paid.paid_loss, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(prem.premium, 0) AS paid_loss_ratio
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Policy_Identifier FROM covered) pol
LEFT JOIN paid ON paid.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem ON prem.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pa.Effective_Date) = 2019 THEN pa.Policy_Amount END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pa.Effective_Date) = 2018 THEN pa.Policy_Amount END) AS premium_increase
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_amount pa ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(pa.Effective_Date) = 2019 THEN pa.Policy_Amount END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(pa.Effective_Date) = 2018 THEN pa.Policy_Amount END)) * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(pa.Effective_Date) = 2018 THEN pa.Policy_Amount END) AS percentage_increase
FROM policy_amount pa
JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
  AND YEAR(pa.Effective_Date) IN (2018, 2019);

       COUNT(DISTINCT pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier) AS covered_insured_objects_with_premium
FROM policy p

  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_amount pa
  ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
 AND pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN premium pr

answer.sql:
SELECT la.Postal_Code,
       SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_annual_premium
FROM premium p
JOIN policy_amount pa ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN insurable_object io ON pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier

answer.sql:
SELECT la.Postal_Code, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier) AS claim_count
FROM claim_coverage cc
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN insurable_object io ON pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
GROUP BY la.Postal_Code
ORDER BY claim_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT la.Postal_Code,
       AVG(date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS avg_claim_closing_days
FROM claim c
JOIN insurable_object io ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY la.Postal_Code;
